en:
# Two to Four Weeks in Menton: How to Organise a Longer Stay

There's a point during a longer holiday in Menton when something rather pleasant happens.

You stop checking Google Maps every time you leave the apartment. You know which bakery makes the croissants you like. You've worked out where to buy tomatoes, which beach feels right in the afternoon and how long it takes to walk to the station.

You might even have a favourite bench.

At that point, you're no longer simply visiting Menton. You're beginning to live here, at least for a little while.

Two to four weeks is enough time to experience the French Riviera differently. You can explore Monaco, Nice and the Italian coast without sacrificing lazy mornings, ordinary routines or evenings spent cooking dinner in your apartment.

But a longer stay requires a little more organisation than a three-day holiday.

Here's how to make it work without turning your Mediterranean escape into a complicated logistical exercise.
fr:
# Deux à quatre semaines à Menton : organiser un séjour plus long

Un séjour prolongé change votre rapport à Menton. Vous finissez par connaître le chemin de la gare, votre boulangerie et le meilleur endroit où vous asseoir face à la mer. Deux à quatre semaines permettent d'alterner Monaco, Nice et la côte italienne avec de vrais jours sans programme. Quelques habitudes pratiques suffisent : il ne s'agit pas de transformer les vacances en gestion domestique.
it:
# Da due a quattro settimane a Mentone: organizzare un soggiorno lungo

Dopo qualche giorno conosci la strada per la stazione, il panificio e una panchina preferita. Da due a quattro settimane permettono di alternare Monaco, Nizza e la costa italiana con giornate tranquille. Bastano alcune abitudini pratiche, senza trasformare la vacanza in una complicata gestione domestica.
uk:
# Два–чотири тижні в Ментоні: як організувати триваліше перебування

Згодом ви вже знаєте дорогу до вокзалу, улюблену пекарню та лавку біля моря. Два–чотири тижні дозволяють чергувати Монако, Ніццу й італійське узбережжя зі спокійними днями. Потрібні лише кілька побутових звичок, а не складний домашній розклад.

en:
## 1. Start with the apartment, not the itinerary

For a weekend, an attractive location and a comfortable bed might be sufficient.

For three or four weeks, the small practical details matter much more.

Before booking, think about how you'll actually spend an ordinary Tuesday.

Will you prepare breakfast? Work for several hours? Wash clothes? Eat lunch at home? Need somewhere to store groceries?

An apartment that looks wonderful in photographs isn't necessarily comfortable for these everyday activities.

### What matters during a longer stay?

| Feature | Why it matters |
| --- | --- |
| Functional kitchen | Makes regular meals and grocery shopping practical |
| Fridge with adequate space | Important for fresh produce and several days of supplies |
| Washing machine or laundry access | Reduces packing and weekly costs |
| Reliable Wi-Fi | Essential for remote work and everyday communication |
| Table and comfortable chair | Useful for working, eating and planning |
| Air conditioning or effective cooling | Particularly important in July and August |
| Heating | Worth confirming for winter stays |
| Walkable grocery shopping | Makes ordinary life significantly easier |
| Noise and light conditions | Important when working or sleeping regularly |
| Lift or manageable stairs | Particularly relevant with luggage, children or reduced mobility |
| Convenient rubbish disposal | A small but recurring part of apartment life |

Also confirm the actual kitchen equipment.

A kitchen may technically exist but contain little more than a microwave, two plates and a frying pan.

For a month-long stay, you'll probably want a saucepan, chopping board, sharp knife, enough utensils and somewhere sensible to dry dishes.

Our advice: Choose an apartment that works for everyday life, not just for the first twenty minutes after arrival.
fr:
## 1. Choisir l'appartement avant le programme

Imaginez un mardi ordinaire : préparer le petit déjeuner, travailler, laver du linge et ranger les courses. Un bel intérieur ne garantit pas que ces activités seront confortables.

| Équipement | Pourquoi le vérifier |
| --- | --- |
| Cuisine fonctionnelle | Préparer régulièrement les repas |
| Réfrigérateur adapté | Garder plusieurs jours de produits frais |
| Lave-linge ou laverie accessible | Alléger les bagages et les dépenses |
| Wi-Fi fiable | Travail et communication |
| Table et chaise confortables | Repas, travail et organisation |
| Climatisation ou rafraîchissement | Particulièrement en juillet et août |
| Chauffage | À confirmer en hiver |
| Courses accessibles à pied | Faciliter le quotidien |
| Bruit et lumière | Sommeil et appels professionnels |
| Ascenseur ou escaliers gérables | Bagages, enfants, mobilité |
| Déchets et tri | Une tâche récurrente |

Demandez aussi quels ustensiles sont réellement disponibles : casserole, planche, couteau, couverts et égouttoir. Une kitchenette peut être très limitée. Vérifiez les équipements de l'appartement choisi, pas ceux que suggère une photographie.
it:
## 1. Prima l'appartamento, poi l'itinerario

Immagina un martedì normale: colazione, lavoro, bucato e spesa. Un ambiente fotogenico non garantisce comodità per tutte queste attività.

| Dotazione | Perché verificarla |
| --- | --- |
| Cucina funzionale | Preparare pasti regolari |
| Frigorifero adeguato | Conservare diversi giorni di prodotti freschi |
| Lavatrice o lavanderia accessibile | Alleggerire bagagli e costi |
| Wi-Fi affidabile | Lavoro e comunicazioni |
| Tavolo e sedia comodi | Mangiare, lavorare e organizzarsi |
| Climatizzazione o raffrescamento | Soprattutto a luglio e agosto |
| Riscaldamento | Da confermare in inverno |
| Spesa raggiungibile a piedi | Semplificare la quotidianità |
| Rumore e luce | Sonno e chiamate |
| Ascensore o scale gestibili | Bagagli, bambini e mobilità |
| Smaltimento dei rifiuti | Una necessità ricorrente |

Chiedi quali utensili ci sono davvero: pentola, tagliere, coltello, stoviglie e scolapiatti. Un angolo cottura può essere essenziale. Verifica la dotazione dell'alloggio scelto, non quella suggerita da un'immagine.
uk:
## 1. Спочатку апартаменти, потім маршрут

Уявіть звичайний вівторок: сніданок, робота, прання, продукти. Гарний інтер'єр на знімку не гарантує зручності для щоденного життя.

| Умова | Навіщо перевіряти |
| --- | --- |
| Функціональна кухня | Регулярно готувати їжу |
| Достатній холодильник | Зберігати свіжі продукти кілька днів |
| Пральна машина чи доступна пральня | Менше багажу й витрат |
| Надійний Wi-Fi | Робота та спілкування |
| Зручні стіл і стілець | Їжа, робота, планування |
| Кондиціонування чи охолодження | Особливо в липні й серпні |
| Опалення | Уточнити для зими |
| Магазини пішки | Простіший побут |
| Шум і світло | Сон та робочі дзвінки |
| Ліфт чи посильні сходи | Валізи, діти, мобільність |
| Вивезення й сортування сміття | Регулярна побутова справа |

Запитайте про реальний кухонний набір: каструлю, дошку, ніж, прибори й сушарку для посуду. Маленька кухня може мати мінімум обладнання. Перевіряйте конкретне помешкання, а не враження від фотографії.

en:
## 2. Your first 48 hours: set up a comfortable routine

There's no need to plan a major excursion immediately after arriving.

Use the first two days to understand your neighbourhood and make the apartment feel like a temporary home.

### Arrival day

Unpack properly, rather than living out of a suitcase for three weeks.

Check the Wi-Fi, kitchen appliances, hot water, air conditioning or heating, and laundry facilities.

Find the nearest supermarket and buy enough for breakfast, drinks and one or two simple meals.

Keep your first dinner uncomplicated. You can eat out or make something easy in the apartment.

Also locate your nearest rubbish and recycling containers, and check the building's disposal instructions.

### Your first full day

Take a relaxed walk around the neighbourhood.

Find a bakery, pharmacy, supermarket, ATM if needed, and the most convenient route to the beach or station.

Make your first proper grocery purchase. Test the kitchen with a simple meal.

If you'll be working remotely, test the internet connection under normal working conditions, especially video calls if those are essential.

By the end of day two, you should have solved most of the practical problems that otherwise interrupt the rest of your holiday.
fr:
## 2. Les premières 48 heures

Le jour d'arrivée, déballez vos affaires, essayez le Wi-Fi, l'eau chaude, la cuisine, le chauffage ou la climatisation et le lave-linge. Achetez le nécessaire pour le petit déjeuner et un dîner simple. Repérez les conteneurs et les consignes de l'immeuble.

Le lendemain, faites une promenade de quartier : boulangerie, pharmacie, supermarché, distributeur si nécessaire, plage et gare. Faites vos premières vraies courses et cuisinez quelque chose de simple. Si vous devez télétravailler, testez une visioconférence dans vos conditions réelles.
it:
## 2. Le prime 48 ore

All'arrivo sistema i bagagli, prova Wi-Fi, acqua calda, cucina, riscaldamento o climatizzazione e lavatrice. Compra il necessario per colazione e una cena semplice. Individua contenitori e regole del condominio.

Il giorno dopo esplora il quartiere: panificio, farmacia, supermercato, bancomat se serve, spiaggia e stazione. Fai la prima spesa completa e prepara un pasto. Se lavori, prova una videochiamata nelle condizioni che userai davvero.
uk:
## 2. Перші 48 годин

У день приїзду розпакуйте речі, перевірте Wi-Fi, гарячу воду, кухню, опалення чи кондиціонер і прання. Купіть продукти на сніданок та просту вечерю. Знайдіть контейнери й дізнайтеся правила будинку.

Наступного дня прогуляйтеся районом: пекарня, аптека, супермаркет, банкомат за потреби, пляж і вокзал. Зробіть першу повну закупівлю та приготуйте просту страву. Для дистанційної роботи перевірте відеодзвінок у реальних умовах.

en:
## 3. Grocery shopping: combine a market with supermarkets

One of the advantages of staying in Menton for several weeks is having time to shop like a resident.

You don't need to eat every meal in a restaurant, but you don't need to give up restaurants either.

A good routine combines a weekly supermarket visit, regular fresh-food shopping and the occasional bakery stop.

### Start with Menton's covered market

Halles Municipales, at Quai de Monléon, is an excellent place to buy fruit, vegetables, cheeses, bread, olives and regional ingredients.

The municipal market operates daily, generally in the morning, with the city publishing hours of 7:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. Individual stall availability varies, and Monday can be quieter.

It's particularly useful for buying ingredients for a lunch at home or a Mediterranean-style dinner.

For example:

- Fresh tomatoes and mozzarella

- Bread and local olive oil

- Seasonal fruit

- Olives, tapenade or other regional products

- Cheese and charcuterie

- Fresh ingredients for a simple pasta dish

You don't have to make the market your only source of food. Think of it as the enjoyable part of shopping.

### Use supermarkets for the practical essentials

For a substantial grocery purchase, a larger supermarket is usually easier.

Intermarché Hyper Menton on Avenue Saint-Roman offers a broader stock-up option, including online ordering and delivery services. Smaller central supermarkets are useful for replacing milk, coffee, fruit and whatever you've forgotten.

If you're carrying several bags on foot, check your return route before making a large purchase.

For apartment guests without a car, two smaller shopping trips may be more comfortable than one enormous one.

Our [supermarket guide for Menton](https://azurmenton.com/en/guide/supermarkets-in-menton) covers local options in more detail.

### A practical weekly shopping rhythm

| When | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| Sunday or Monday | Plan meals and check remaining supplies |
| Monday or Tuesday | Main grocery shop for 4–5 days |
| Wednesday | Visit the market for fresh produce |
| Friday | Buy ingredients for weekend meals and picnics |
| Throughout the week | Pick up bread, fruit and essentials as needed |

This is a suggested routine, not a strict timetable.

The idea is to reduce repetitive shopping while keeping enough flexibility to enjoy restaurants and spontaneous outings.
fr:
## 3. Associer marché et supermarchés

Les Halles municipales, quai de Monléon, proposent des produits frais. La ville publie une ouverture quotidienne de 7 h 30 à 13 h ; la présence de chaque commerçant varie. Tomates, fromage, pain, olives et fruits permettent de composer des repas sans grande préparation.

Intermarché Hyper Menton, 45 avenue Saint-Roman, est une option pour les grosses courses ; sa page officielle mentionne drive et livraison, selon les créneaux. Les magasins centraux servent pour les compléments. À pied, deux petites sorties peuvent être plus confortables qu'un retour très chargé. Consultez notre [guide des supermarchés](https://azurmenton.com/fr/guide/supermarkets-in-menton).

| Moment | Organisation possible |
| --- | --- |
| Dimanche ou lundi | Prévoir les repas et vérifier les réserves |
| Lundi ou mardi | Courses principales pour 4–5 jours |
| Mercredi | Produits frais au marché |
| Vendredi | Repas du week-end et pique-niques |
| Dans la semaine | Pain, fruits et petits oublis |

C'est un exemple souple, pas un calendrier imposé.
it:
## 3. Mercato e supermercati insieme

Le Halles municipali, quai de Monléon, offrono prodotti freschi. Il Comune pubblica l'apertura quotidiana dalle 7:30 alle 13; i singoli banchi possono variare. Pomodori, formaggio, pane, olive e frutta bastano per pasti poco impegnativi.

Intermarché Hyper Menton, 45 avenue Saint-Roman, è un'opzione per fare scorta; la pagina ufficiale indica ritiro e consegna, secondo disponibilità. I negozi centrali servono per le integrazioni. A piedi, due spese piccole possono essere più comode di molte borse insieme. Consulta la [guida ai supermercati](https://azurmenton.com/it/guide/supermarkets-in-menton).

| Quando | Possibile organizzazione |
| --- | --- |
| Domenica o lunedì | Pianificare pasti e controllare scorte |
| Lunedì o martedì | Spesa principale per 4–5 giorni |
| Mercoledì | Prodotti freschi al mercato |
| Venerdì | Pasti del fine settimana e picnic |
| Durante la settimana | Pane, frutta e piccole necessità |

È un esempio flessibile, non un orario obbligatorio.
uk:
## 3. Поєднуйте ринок із супермаркетами

Муніципальні Halles на quai de Monléon підходять для свіжих продуктів. Місто вказує щоденний час 7:30–13:00; окремі продавці працюють по-різному. Помідори, сир, хліб, оливки й фрукти допомагають готувати без складних рецептів.

Intermarché Hyper Menton, 45 avenue Saint-Roman, можна розглянути для великих закупівель. Офіційна сторінка зазначає самовивіз і доставку залежно від доступних слотів. Центральні магазини зручні для поповнення запасів. Пішки дві невеликі закупівлі можуть бути легшими за кілька важких сумок. Є окремий [гайд супермаркетами](https://azurmenton.com/uk/guide/supermarkets-in-menton).

| Коли | Можливий ритм |
| --- | --- |
| Неділя чи понеділок | Спланувати страви, перевірити запаси |
| Понеділок чи вівторок | Основна закупівля на 4–5 днів |
| Середа | Свіжі продукти на ринку |
| П'ятниця | Їжа на вихідні та пікніки |
| Протягом тижня | Хліб, фрукти й дрібні покупки |

Це гнучкий приклад, не обов'язковий графік.

en:
## 4. How much does a week of apartment living cost?

Accommodation is the biggest variable in a longer stay, so we've deliberately excluded it from the following calculations.

These are editorial spending allowances for groceries, dining out, transport and activities, not a survey of local prices. They exclude accommodation, travel to Menton, insurance and any refundable deposit. Laundry and other extras need their own allowance.

### Weekly budget per adult, excluding accommodation

| Expense | Economical | Comfortable | Experience-focused |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Groceries and household consumables | €75 | €100 | €125 |
| Restaurants, cafés and drinks | €90 | €205 | €340 |
| Local transport and excursions | €20 | €45 | €75 |
| Activities and entertainment | €25 | €70 | €160 |
| Weekly total | €210 | €420 | €700 |

These figures are planning scenarios, not recorded averages of actual visitor spending.

The economical budget assumes substantial home cooking, casual dining and mostly free activities.

The comfortable budget allows regular restaurant meals, café visits, public transport and paid excursions.

The experience-focused budget makes room for better restaurants, beach clubs and more frequent activities while still taking advantage of having a kitchen.

### Total spending for two, three or four weeks

| Stay length | Economical | Comfortable | Experience-focused |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 weeks | €420 | €840 | €1,400 |
| 3 weeks | €630 | €1,260 | €2,100 |
| 4 weeks | €840 | €1,680 | €2,800 |

All totals are per adult. For two adults, double the baseline as a simple planning estimate, although shared groceries and household supplies may reduce the combined cost.

### Why can longer stays cost less per day?

A short holiday encourages spending.

You arrive, visit attractions, eat out frequently and try to fit several experiences into a limited number of days.

During a longer stay, that urgency disappears.

You can make breakfast, enjoy a free beach day, cook dinner occasionally and spread larger excursions across several weeks.

The comfortable weekly estimate above works out to €60 per person per day, compared with the €85 daily scenario used in our shorter-holiday budget guide.

The difference comes from a different pattern of behaviour, not necessarily cheaper prices.

It assumes more home cooking, fewer paid activities and a slower travel rhythm.

For a safer allowance, add around 10–15% for unexpected expenses or particularly active weeks.

Read our [Menton holiday budget guide](https://azurmenton.com/en/guide/menton-holiday-budget) for shorter-stay comparisons and restaurant spending examples.
fr:
## 4. Quel budget hebdomadaire ?

Les montants suivants sont des scénarios éditoriaux par adulte, pas des moyennes observées ni un relevé officiel de prix. Ils excluent logement, voyage jusqu'à Menton, assurance et éventuelle caution. Prévoyez séparément laverie et extras.

| Dépense | Économe | Confortable | Expériences |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Courses et consommables | €75 | €100 | €125 |
| Restaurants, cafés et boissons | €90 | €205 | €340 |
| Transport et excursions | €20 | €45 | €75 |
| Activités | €25 | €70 | €160 |
| Total hebdomadaire | €210 | €420 | €700 |

Le premier scénario privilégie la cuisine et les activités gratuites. Le deuxième permet des restaurants et des sorties régulières. Le troisième laisse davantage de place aux expériences payantes.

| Durée | Économe | Confortable | Expériences |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 semaines | €420 | €840 | €1,400 |
| 3 semaines | €630 | €1,260 | €2,100 |
| 4 semaines | €840 | €1,680 | €2,800 |

Pour deux adultes, doubler constitue un point de départ ; certains achats se partagent. Le scénario confortable équivaut à €60 par jour, contre €85 dans notre exemple de court séjour : la différence vient du rythme et de la cuisine, pas d'une promesse de prix réduits. Ajoutez une marge indicative de 10–15 %. Comparez avec le [budget de vacances à Menton](https://azurmenton.com/fr/guide/menton-holiday-budget).
it:
## 4. Quanto spendere ogni settimana?

Sono scenari editoriali per adulto, non medie rilevate o statistiche ufficiali. Escludono alloggio, viaggio fino a Mentone, assicurazione ed eventuale deposito. Bucato ed extra richiedono un margine separato.

| Spesa | Economico | Comodo | Esperienze |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Alimentari e consumabili | €75 | €100 | €125 |
| Ristoranti, caffè e bevande | €90 | €205 | €340 |
| Trasporti ed escursioni | €20 | €45 | €75 |
| Attività | €25 | €70 | €160 |
| Totale settimanale | €210 | €420 | €700 |

Il primo scenario privilegia cucina e attività gratuite; il secondo permette uscite e ristoranti regolari; il terzo più esperienze a pagamento.

| Durata | Economico | Comodo | Esperienze |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 settimane | €420 | €840 | €1,400 |
| 3 settimane | €630 | €1,260 | €2,100 |
| 4 settimane | €840 | €1,680 | €2,800 |

Per due adulti raddoppiare è una base, ma alcuni acquisti si condividono. Lo scenario comodo equivale a €60 al giorno contro €85 nell'esempio di vacanza breve: cambia il ritmo, non si promettono prezzi inferiori. Aggiungi un margine indicativo del 10–15 %. Confronta la [guida al budget](https://azurmenton.com/it/guide/menton-holiday-budget).
uk:
## 4. Скільки закладати на тиждень?

Нижче редакційні сценарії на дорослого, не статистичні середні й не офіційне дослідження цін. Проживання, дорога до Ментона, страхування та можлива застава не включені. Прання й інші додаткові витрати потребують окремого запасу.

| Витрата | Економно | Комфортно | Більше вражень |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Продукти й побутові дрібниці | €75 | €100 | €125 |
| Ресторани, кав'ярні та напої | €90 | €205 | €340 |
| Транспорт і поїздки | €20 | €45 | €75 |
| Активності | €25 | €70 | €160 |
| Разом за тиждень | €210 | €420 | €700 |

Перший сценарій передбачає домашню їжу й переважно безкоштовні заняття. Другий дозволяє регулярні ресторани та виїзди. Третій залишає більше коштів на платні враження.

| Тривалість | Економно | Комфортно | Більше вражень |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 тижні | €420 | €840 | €1,400 |
| 3 тижні | €630 | €1,260 | €2,100 |
| 4 тижні | €840 | €1,680 | €2,800 |

Для двох дорослих подвоєння дає початковий орієнтир, хоча деякі покупки спільні. Комфортний приклад дорівнює €60 на день проти €85 у сценарії короткої відпустки: змінюється поведінка, а не гарантовано ціни. Додайте орієнтовні 10–15 % запасу. Порівняйте з [бюджетом відпочинку](https://azurmenton.com/uk/guide/menton-holiday-budget).

en:
## 5. What should you actually cook?

Nobody comes to Menton to spend every evening washing pans.

The goal isn't to recreate your entire domestic routine. It's to make eating simple enough that restaurants remain a pleasure rather than an obligation.

Here is one example of a realistic apartment week.

| Day | Lunch | Dinner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Monday | Bakery sandwich and fruit | Pasta with tomatoes, pesto and salad |
| Tuesday | Lunch at a local restaurant | Cheese, bread, olives and vegetables |
| Wednesday | Leftovers or market picnic | Fish or vegetables with potatoes |
| Thursday | Lunch during an excursion | Simple apartment dinner |
| Friday | Salad or takeaway | Restaurant dinner |
| Saturday | Beach picnic | Homemade pasta or takeaway pizza |
| Sunday | Long restaurant lunch | Light dinner using remaining groceries |

This keeps food preparation manageable.

A useful approach is to prepare ingredients rather than elaborate dishes. Wash vegetables, keep cheese and fruit available, and plan meals that take no more than twenty minutes.

It also helps reduce food waste, especially towards the end of your stay.
fr:
## 5. Que cuisiner sans y passer les vacances ?

Préparez des ingrédients simples plutôt que des recettes compliquées. Gardez fruits, légumes lavés et fromage à portée de main ; terminez les réserves avant le départ.

| Jour | Déjeuner | Dîner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lundi | Sandwich et fruit | Pâtes, tomates et salade |
| Mardi | Restaurant local | Fromage, pain, olives et légumes |
| Mercredi | Restes ou pique-nique du marché | Poisson ou légumes et pommes de terre |
| Jeudi | Déjeuner en excursion | Repas simple à l'appartement |
| Vendredi | Salade ou plat à emporter | Restaurant |
| Samedi | Pique-nique à la plage | Pâtes ou pizza à emporter |
| Dimanche | Long déjeuner au restaurant | Repas léger avec les réserves |

## 6. Laundry: the small detail that changes everything

For a two-week stay, laundry is convenient.

For four weeks, it's practically essential.

The best solution is an apartment with a washing machine, but that isn't always available.

Check the property description before booking and ask whether detergent, a drying rack or a dryer is provided.

### If your apartment has a washing machine

Plan one or two laundry sessions each week.

Choose a day when you'll spend several hours at home rather than starting a wash just before leaving for Monaco.

In summer, lightweight clothing may dry fairly quickly in suitable conditions. However, avoid assuming that every balcony allows clothes drying, and follow the building's rules.

### If your apartment doesn't have a washing machine

Look for a local laverie automatique, the French term for a self-service laundrette.

One practical option to investigate is the laundry service listed at Intermarché Hyper Menton, Avenue Saint-Roman. Confirm machine availability, access and payment arrangements before relying on it.

As a rough allowance, set aside €8–15 for a wash-and-dry session, depending on machine size, detergent and drying time. This is an estimate, not a confirmed Menton laundrette tariff.

### How much clothing should you pack?

For a stay with convenient laundry facilities, seven to ten days of everyday clothes will often be enough.

Bring a few versatile pieces, comfortable shoes and suitable layers for the season.

You don't need four weeks of separate outfits.
fr:
## 6. Le linge, un détail décisif

Vérifiez lave-linge, lessive, séchoir et éventuel sèche-linge avant de réserver. Une ou deux lessives par semaine peuvent suffire ; respectez les règles de l'immeuble, notamment pour le séchage au balcon.

Sans machine, repérez une laverie automatique. Intermarché Saint-Roman en mentionne une, mais disponibilité, accès et paiement restent à vérifier. L'enveloppe de €8–15 par lavage et séchage est une estimation, pas un tarif confirmé. Avec une solution pratique, des vêtements pour sept à dix jours, des chaussures confortables et des couches adaptées à la saison évitent quatre semaines de tenues différentes.
it:
## 6. Il bucato cambia il soggiorno

Conferma lavatrice, detersivo, stendino ed eventuale asciugatrice. Una o due sessioni settimanali possono bastare. Rispetta le regole dell'edificio, anche per stendere sul balcone.

Senza macchina, cerca una lavanderia automatica. Intermarché Saint-Roman ne elenca una, ma accesso, disponibilità e pagamento vanno verificati. €8–15 per lavaggio e asciugatura è una stima, non una tariffa confermata. Con un servizio comodo bastano spesso vestiti per sette-dieci giorni, scarpe pratiche e strati adatti alla stagione.
uk:
## 6. Прання змінює все

До бронювання уточніть машину, засіб, сушарку й можливість сушіння. Одного-двох прань на тиждень часто достатньо. Дотримуйтеся правил будинку, зокрема щодо речей на балконі.

Якщо машини немає, знайдіть автоматичну пральню. Intermarché Saint-Roman зазначає таку послугу, але доступ, наявність машин і спосіб оплати треба уточнити. €8–15 за прання та сушіння — оцінка, не підтверджений місцевий тариф. За зручного прання часто вистачить одягу на сім–десять днів, комфортного взуття й сезонних шарів.

en:
## 7. Working remotely without losing the holiday

A longer stay may include working days.

That doesn't mean you need a coworking membership or a complicated digital nomad routine.

For many visitors, the apartment itself is the most practical place to work.

What matters is making work compatible with the rhythm of Menton.

### A realistic working day

7:30–9:00 a.m. Breakfast, coffee and a walk beside the sea.

9:00 a.m.–12:30 p.m. Focused work in the apartment.

12:30–2:00 p.m. Lunch, a few errands or a short walk.

2:00–5:00 p.m. Meetings or the remaining work session.

After 5:00 p.m. Swimming, a restaurant, a walk through the old town or a quiet evening.

Naturally, your schedule may differ if your clients or colleagues operate in another time zone.

The important thing is to give work a defined place in the day.

Otherwise, you risk spending your holiday half-working and half-feeling guilty about not exploring.

### Check these before booking

Ask about the internet connection's reliability and, where possible, speed.

A phone hotspot or mobile data plan is useful as a backup, but coverage and roaming allowances vary. Confirm your provider's conditions, particularly if you rely on a non-EU mobile contract.

Check whether there's a proper table, practical seating, power outlets and a quiet space for calls.

In summer, make sure the room can remain comfortable during the hottest hours.

Also consider the apartment's layout if two people need to work simultaneously.

A quiet apartment with a reliable connection is generally more valuable than a list of nearby coworking spaces.
fr:
## 7. Télétravailler sans perdre les vacances

Une journée possible : promenade et petit déjeuner de 7 h 30 à 9 h, travail jusqu'à 12 h 30, déjeuner et courses jusqu'à 14 h, réunions jusqu'à 17 h, puis soirée libre. Adaptez ce rythme à votre fuseau professionnel et, en hiver, à la lumière plutôt qu'à une baignade garantie.

Demandez une connexion adaptée, une table, des prises, une assise correcte et du calme pour les appels. Deux personnes qui travaillent ont parfois besoin d'espaces distincts. Testez votre solution mobile de secours et ses conditions d'itinérance. Ni une illustration ni la présence du Wi-Fi ne garantissent le débit réel. Vérifiez aussi vos conditions d'emploi, de séjour et d'assurance.
it:
## 7. Lavorare da remoto senza perdere la vacanza

Un esempio: colazione e passeggiata 7:30–9, lavoro fino alle 12:30, pranzo e commissioni fino alle 14, riunioni fino alle 17 e serata libera. Adattalo al fuso dei colleghi e alla luce invernale, senza contare sempre su un bagno al mare.

Chiedi connessione adeguata, tavolo, prese, seduta e tranquillità per le chiamate. Due persone potrebbero aver bisogno di spazi distinti. Prova la connessione mobile di riserva e controlla roaming e limiti. La semplice presenza del Wi-Fi non garantisce prestazioni. Valuta anche la tua situazione lavorativa, migratoria e assicurativa.
uk:
## 7. Дистанційна робота без втрати відпустки

Можливий день: сніданок і прогулянка 7:30–9:00, робота до 12:30, обід і справи до 14:00, зустрічі до 17:00, потім вільний вечір. Зважайте на часовий пояс колег і зимове світло; купання після роботи не гарантоване.

Перевірте інтернет, стіл, розетки, стілець і тишу для дзвінків. Двом людям можуть знадобитися різні робочі зони. Протестуйте мобільний резерв та умови роумінгу. Сам факт Wi-Fi не гарантує швидкості. Окремо врахуйте власні трудові, міграційні й страхові обставини.

en:
## 8. Alternate local days and excursions

This is probably the single most useful principle for a longer stay in Menton:

Don't turn every day into a sightseeing day.

One of Menton's advantages is its location. You can visit other Riviera destinations and still return to the same apartment in the evening.

But travelling somewhere new every day becomes tiring, expensive and strangely repetitive.

Instead, alternate three types of days.

### Local days

Stay in Menton.

Visit the market, swim, read, work, cook, walk through the old town or discover a different section of the seafront.

These days don't require much planning.

### Excursion days

Choose one destination and enjoy it without rushing.

Monaco works well for museums, gardens and sightseeing.

Nice offers a larger city atmosphere, markets, galleries and museums.

Ventimiglia provides an easy introduction to the Italian side of the border, with food, markets and a different rhythm of life.

### Recovery days

Do less.

Sleep a little longer, take care of laundry, stock the fridge, sit beside the sea or enjoy an afternoon without obligations.

Recovery days aren't wasted holiday time.

They're often what makes a three-week trip more enjoyable than an exhausting seven-day itinerary.
fr:
## 8. Alterner journées locales et excursions

Les journées mentonnaises peuvent mêler marché, lecture, travail, cuisine et promenade. Les journées d'excursion se concentrent sur une destination : Monaco, Nice ou Vintimille, sans multiplier les objectifs. Vérifiez horaires, dernier retour et billet pour l'Italie.

Gardez des journées de récupération pour le linge, les courses et le repos. Elles ne sont pas perdues : elles rendent un séjour de trois semaines soutenable.
it:
## 8. Alternare giornate locali ed escursioni

Le giornate a Mentone possono includere mercato, lettura, lavoro, cucina e passeggiate. Per le escursioni scegli una destinazione: Monaco, Nizza o Ventimiglia, senza accumulare obiettivi. Controlla orari, ultimo ritorno e biglietto per la tratta italiana.

Lascia giorni di recupero per bucato, spesa e riposo. Non sono giorni persi: rendono sostenibile un viaggio lungo.
uk:
## 8. Чергуйте місцеві дні та поїздки

У Ментоні можна поєднувати ринок, читання, роботу, кухню й прогулянки. Для виїзного дня обирайте одне місце: Монако, Ніццу чи Вентімілью. Перевіряйте розклад, останній зворотний рейс і квиток на італійський відрізок.

Залишайте відновлювальні дні для прання, продуктів і відпочинку. Вони не змарновані: саме завдяки їм довга подорож не виснажує.

## 9. A sample week: the rhythm we recommend

| Wednesday | Day trip to Monaco or Italy | Light dinner at home |

| Saturday | Full-day excursion or cultural activity | Flexible |
| Sunday | Slow breakfast, rest and planning | Home-cooked meal or takeaway |

For a remote worker, move the excursions to free days and keep work sessions consistent.

For a fully retired or holiday-focused traveller, use the same framework more loosely.

There is no need to fill every empty space.

## 10. A two-week, three-week and four-week plan

### Two weeks: balance discovery with downtime

During the first week, focus on Menton.

Explore the town, identify your favourite cafés, visit the market and become familiar with the beaches and local transport.

Include one substantial excursion.

During the second week, add two or three trips farther along the coast, alternating them with restful days in Menton.

Suggested rhythm: Three to four excursions across fourteen days.

### Three weeks: develop a routine

The first week is about settling in.

The second can include more ambitious outings, cultural visits and exploration of nearby villages.

By the third week, you'll probably have found places you want to revisit.

You may also discover that spending an entire day doing almost nothing feels perfectly natural.

Suggested rhythm: Four to six excursions across twenty-one days.

### Four weeks: live at your own pace

A month allows a genuinely different experience.

You can repeat favourite activities, experiment with local cooking, schedule regular working days and explore destinations beyond the most obvious tourist stops.

There is no need to complete a list.

You can spend several days in Menton, take an excursion, then return to your ordinary seaside routine.

Suggested rhythm: Five to eight excursions across twenty-eight days, depending on energy, season and working commitments.

These are editorial suggestions, not sightseeing targets.
fr:
## 10. Deux, trois ou quatre semaines

Deux semaines : découvrez d'abord Menton, puis alternez sorties et repos. Trois à quatre excursions sur quatorze jours constituent une suggestion raisonnable.

Trois semaines : installez votre routine, élargissez les découvertes puis retournez dans vos endroits préférés. Quatre à six excursions sur vingt et un jours restent un exemple, pas un objectif.

Quatre semaines : laissez davantage de place aux habitudes, au travail éventuel et aux imprévus. Cinq à huit sorties sur vingt-huit jours peuvent suffire, selon énergie et saison.
it:
## 10. Due, tre o quattro settimane

Due settimane: scopri prima Mentone, poi alterna uscite e riposo. Tre-quattro escursioni in quattordici giorni sono una proposta ragionevole.

Tre settimane: crea una routine, amplia le scoperte e torna nei posti preferiti. Quattro-sei uscite in ventuno giorni sono un esempio, non un traguardo.

Quattro settimane: dedica più spazio alle abitudini, al lavoro eventuale e agli imprevisti. Cinque-otto uscite in ventotto giorni possono bastare, secondo stagione ed energie.
uk:
## 10. План на два, три чи чотири тижні

Два тижні: спочатку освоїти Ментон, потім чергувати виїзди з відпочинком. Три-чотири поїздки за чотирнадцять днів — лише можливий ритм.

Три тижні: налаштувати побут, розширити знайомство з околицями й повернутися до улюблених місць. Чотири–шість виїздів за двадцять один день не є обов'язковою метою.

Чотири тижні: більше звичних справ, роботи за потреби та спонтанності. П'яти–восьми виїздів за двадцять вісім днів може вистачити залежно від сил і сезону.

## 11. Public transport for longer stays

For most visitors staying centrally, a car isn't essential.

Menton has regional train connections along the coast, and the Zest bus network serves the town and surrounding area.

For longer stays, travel passes are worth comparing.

### Published adult transport prices checked on 5 November 2026

| Ticket or pass | Published adult price |
| --- | --- |
| Zest single ticket | €2 |
| Zest one-day pass | €5 |
| Zest seven-day pass | €13 |
| Zest monthly pass | €38 |
| Pass Sud Azur tourist, 7 days | €50 |
| Pass Sud Azur tourist, 14 days | €80 |

The local Zest monthly pass is based on the calendar month, not a rolling thirty-day period. It requires a Zest smartcard; the operator sells it from the 20th of the previous month to the 19th of the current month. A stay crossing two calendar months needs a fresh comparison with seven-day tickets.

Pass SudAzur Explore covers participating train, bus and tram networks in the Alpes-Maritimes and Monaco. The published coastal rail boundary is Menton Garavan, not Ventimiglia: do not assume the Italian section is included. Check the specific service, ticket medium and extra charges before buying. At Lignes d'Azur machines the operator states a refundable €2 deposit for the anonymous card.

Don't automatically buy a pass for the full length of your stay.

If you're spending most of your time walking around Menton, individual tickets may be more economical.

If you've planned multiple regional excursions within a particular week, a suitable travel pass may offer better value.

For train services, check [SNCF Connect](https://www.sncf-connect.com/) and compare actual fares for your travel dates and service updates before each excursion.

en:
## 12. The little things people forget about apartment stays

Some problems only become noticeable after several days.

It's worth dealing with them early.

### Household supplies

Check whether the apartment provides toilet paper, washing-up liquid, laundry detergent, rubbish bags and basic cleaning products.

A starter supply doesn't necessarily mean the property provides unlimited replenishment for a month.

### Rubbish and recycling

Ask where and when to dispose of household waste, and how recycling works in the building.

Don't leave bags in corridors or common areas.

### Cleaning

For a longer stay, ask what cleaning is included, whether fresh linen or towels are provided during the visit, and whether optional cleaning services are available.

Some apartments operate on a self-maintenance basis between arrival and departure.

### Deliveries and parcels

If you're ordering groceries or receiving packages, confirm the correct delivery address and whether the building has an intercom.

Don't assume a holiday rental can receive mail or parcels on your behalf without prior agreement.

### Medicines and emergencies

Locate a nearby pharmacy during the first few days.

Bring enough of any regular medication for the full stay, accounting for possible travel delays, and check the rules for bringing it into France.

For serious emergencies in France, call 112.

### Seasonal differences

During summer, prioritise cooling, shade and early outdoor activities.

In winter, confirm heating, daylight-sensitive plans and seasonal opening hours.

Autumn can bring heavy rain, so keep excursion dates flexible.

For seasonal planning, explore [Menton in autumn](https://azurmenton.com/en/guide/menton-in-autumn) and our [other local guides](https://azurmenton.com/en/guide).

## 12. Les détails faciles à oublier

Clarifiez les consommables fournis et leur renouvellement : papier, sacs, produits ménagers et lessive. Demandez les règles de tri, le ménage inclus et les éventuels changements de linge. Ne laissez pas les déchets dans les parties communes.

Livraisons et colis nécessitent une adresse et un accord adaptés ; l'hébergement n'est pas automatiquement un service postal. Repérez une pharmacie et préparez vos médicaments selon votre situation et les règles applicables. En cas d'urgence grave en France, composez le 112.

En été, pensez fraîcheur et ombre ; en hiver, chauffage et horaires saisonniers. L'automne demande de la souplesse face aux pluies. Consultez [Menton en automne](https://azurmenton.com/fr/guide/menton-in-autumn).
it:
## 12. I piccoli dettagli dimenticati

Chiarisci scorte iniziali e rinnovo di carta, sacchi, detergenti e detersivo. Chiedi regole del riciclo, pulizia compresa e cambio della biancheria. Non lasciare rifiuti negli spazi comuni.

Consegne e pacchi richiedono indirizzo corretto e accordo: l'alloggio non è automaticamente un servizio postale. Individua una farmacia e prepara i farmaci secondo situazione personale e regole applicabili. Per una grave emergenza in Francia chiama il 112.

In estate privilegia fresco e ombra; in inverno riscaldamento e aperture stagionali. In autunno lascia flessibilità per la pioggia. Leggi [Mentone in autunno](https://azurmenton.com/it/guide/menton-in-autumn).
uk:
## 12. Дрібниці, про які легко забути

Уточніть початкові запаси й поповнення паперу, пакетів, мийних засобів і порошку. Дізнайтеся правила сортування, включене прибирання й заміну білизни. Не лишайте сміття у спільних коридорах.

Доставка й посилки потребують правильної адреси та домовленості: апартаменти не є автоматично поштовою службою. Знайдіть аптеку та підготуйте ліки відповідно до власної ситуації й чинних правил. У разі серйозної надзвичайної ситуації у Франції телефонуйте 112.

Улітку важливі прохолода й тінь, узимку — опалення та сезонні години. Восени залишайте гнучкість через дощі. Є [гайд осіннім Ментоном](https://azurmenton.com/uk/guide/menton-in-autumn).

## 13. How to keep a month-long stay enjoyable

A longer holiday doesn't become better just because you visit more places.

Often, the opposite is true.

If you plan a different excursion every morning, book restaurants every evening and fill every gap with a must-see attraction, you'll recreate the pressure of a short holiday over a much longer period.

Try maintaining a few simple routines instead.

Find a morning walk you genuinely enjoy.

Keep your fridge stocked with easy breakfast ingredients.

Choose two or three restaurants you might like to revisit.

Set aside time each week for groceries, laundry and any work commitments.

Have at least one day without a fixed plan.

And leave room to change your mind.

A sunny morning might turn into an unexpected beach day. A rainy afternoon might be better spent cooking, reading or visiting a museum.

That's part of the appeal of having more time.
fr:
## 13. Garder le plaisir d'un mois sur place

Choisissez une promenade du matin, quelques restaurants où revenir et un créneau de courses et de lessive. Gardez une journée sans programme. La météo peut transformer une sortie en lecture ou en visite intérieure : c'est l'avantage d'avoir du temps.
it:
## 13. Conservare il piacere di un mese al mare

Scegli una passeggiata mattutina, alcuni ristoranti dove tornare e un momento per spesa e bucato. Tieni una giornata senza impegni. Il tempo può trasformare un'uscita in lettura o visita al coperto: avere settimane permette di cambiare idea.
uk:
## 13. Як зберегти задоволення від місяця біля моря

Оберіть ранкову прогулянку, кілька ресторанів для повторних візитів і час для продуктів та прання. Залиште день без плану. Погода може замінити виїзд читанням чи музеєм: запас часу дозволяє передумати.

en:
## 14. Frequently asked questions

### Is Menton a good place to stay for a month?

Yes, particularly if you enjoy a walkable coastal town with markets, restaurants, beaches and transport connections to nearby destinations. The experience is very different from a short sightseeing visit.

### Can I stay in Menton for several weeks without renting a car?

Yes. A central apartment, regional trains and local buses can cover many everyday needs and coastal excursions. A car may be useful for specific destinations but isn't essential for every visitor.

### How much spending money do I need for three weeks in Menton?

Excluding accommodation, a comfortable planning allowance is approximately €1,260 per adult for three weeks. More economical stays could work around €630, while experience-focused holidays may reach €2,100 or more. Actual spending depends heavily on dining and activities.

### Is it cheaper to cook in an apartment?

Usually, cooking a portion of your meals reduces costs compared with eating out every day. The saving depends on how you shop, what you cook and how much food you waste.

### How many excursions should I plan for a two-week stay?

Three or four substantial day trips are a reasonable starting point. Add more if you enjoy frequent travel, or fewer if you prefer beaches and slow days.

### Should I book an apartment with a washing machine?

It's highly convenient, particularly for three or four weeks. If there's no washing machine, check for accessible local laundry facilities before arrival.

### Can I work remotely from an apartment in Menton?

Potentially, yes, provided the internet connection and workspace suit your needs. Confirm the practical details with the property before booking, and check any employment, immigration or insurance conditions that apply to your circumstances.
fr:
## 14. Questions fréquentes

### Menton convient-elle pour un mois ?

Oui pour un rythme côtier et quotidien, à condition que le logement et la saison correspondent à vos besoins.

### Peut-on rester sans voiture ?

Souvent oui avec un logement central et des transports adaptés ; certains villages demandent davantage de préparation.

### Quel budget pour trois semaines ?

Hors logement, les scénarios sont €630, €1,260 ou €2,100 par adulte. Ce ne sont ni des devis ni des dépenses moyennes.

### Cuisiner fait-il économiser ?

Cela peut réduire les repas au restaurant ; achats et gaspillage changent le résultat.

### Combien d'excursions en deux semaines ?

Trois ou quatre donnent un point de départ, à réduire ou augmenter selon votre envie.

### Faut-il un lave-linge ?

Très pratique, surtout pour trois ou quatre semaines ; sinon, vérifiez une laverie accessible.

### Peut-on télétravailler ?

Si connexion, espace et situation personnelle le permettent. Faites confirmer les conditions avant de réserver.
it:
## 14. Domande frequenti

### Mentone è adatta a un mese?

Sì per un ritmo costiero quotidiano, se alloggio e stagione rispondono alle tue esigenze.

### Posso restare senza auto?

Spesso sì in centro con trasporti adatti; alcuni borghi richiedono più pianificazione.

### Quanto prevedere per tre settimane?

Escluso l'alloggio, gli esempi sono €630, €1,260 o €2,100 per adulto. Non sono preventivi o medie statistiche.

### Cucinare fa risparmiare?

Può ridurre i pasti fuori; acquisti e sprechi incidono sul risultato.

### Quante escursioni in due settimane?

Tre o quattro sono una base da adattare ai tuoi interessi.

### Serve una lavatrice?

È molto comoda per tre-quattro settimane; altrimenti verifica una lavanderia raggiungibile.

### Posso lavorare da remoto?

Se connessione, spazio e situazione personale lo permettono. Conferma prima della prenotazione.
uk:
## 14. Поширені запитання

### Чи підходить Ментон для місяця?

Так для спокійного прибережного побуту, якщо помешкання й сезон відповідають вашим потребам.

### Чи можна без автомобіля?

Часто так у центрі з відповідними транспортними планами; деякі села потребують ретельнішої підготовки.

### Скільки коштів на три тижні?

Без проживання приклади становлять €630, €1,260 або €2,100 на дорослого. Це не кошторис і не статистична середня.

### Чи економить домашня кухня?

Може зменшити ресторанні витрати; результат залежить від покупок і харчових відходів.

### Скільки поїздок на два тижні?

Три-чотири — початкова пропозиція, яку можна змінювати.

### Чи потрібна пральна машина?

Дуже зручно для трьох-чотирьох тижнів; інакше перевірте доступну пральню.

### Чи можна працювати дистанційно?

Якщо дозволяють зв'язок, простір і ваша ситуація. Уточніть усе до бронювання.

en:
## Final thoughts: make Menton your temporary home

A weekend in Menton is about discovering the town.

A week is about enjoying it.

But two, three or four weeks give you time to build a small life around the Mediterranean.

You'll learn where to buy your favourite bread. You'll find the best time to visit the market. You'll probably start recognising familiar faces along your morning walk.

You'll also discover that a perfectly ordinary day can be one of the most memorable parts of a longer holiday.

A little planning makes all of that easier.

Choose the right apartment, organise a manageable grocery and laundry routine, keep your weekly spending under control and leave enough space between excursions.

Then allow yourself to enjoy Menton without treating every day like a checklist.
fr:
## Pour finir : un chez-soi temporaire

Quelques habitudes rendent le séjour plus simple : cuisine utilisable, courses, linge, budget et repos entre les excursions. Une journée ordinaire peut devenir un souvenir aussi fort qu'une grande visite.
it:
## In conclusione: una casa temporanea

Cucina utilizzabile, spesa, bucato, budget e riposo semplificano tutto. Anche una giornata ordinaria può diventare un ricordo forte quanto una grande visita.
uk:
## На завершення: тимчасовий дім

Зручна кухня, продукти, прання, бюджет і відпочинок між виїздами спрощують перебування. Звичайний день іноді запам'ятовується не менше за велику екскурсію.
